notes.title: Version 2.1
notes.content:
[*] Fixed the achievement not unlocking
[*] Fixed a few instances of trees not blocking the player
[*] Fixed a few problematic spots in the level
[*] Other level improvements
[*] Performance improvements

notes.title: Lumen improved and setup
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Onion comments now fade in & out, and Onion can move to hint stuff to the player.
[*] Music is fixed and uses message system to work.
[*] The boss has a phase change and the attack were slightly changed.
[*] Player may now directly damage the Boss.
[*] Added a bunch new vfx for attacks.
[*] Added ambient vfx & sfx.
[*] Added knockback & hitstop.
[*] Updated some sound effects.
[*] Added supper corruption and spiked bushes as stage hazards.
[*] Added cuttable ferns/grass.
[*] Added a new quest to obtain the metal pipe weapon.
[*] Added 3 new consumable items.
[*] Updated the audio balance with ambient music and made it more varied in each region.
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Made level changes.
[*] Added item respawning and inventory saving.
[*] Added better fog.
[*] Improved lighting.
[*] Added achievements.
[*] Added a new intro cutscene.
[*] Optimized collision for buildings.
[*] Changed some textures.
[*] Added distance fields to small foliage.
[*] Made interaction popups consistent.
[*] Added new fonts.
[*] Other minor improvements.
[*] Added new visual options & settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2

[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
